digest.component_or_area: Rebar reconciler recovery gate (RP-02/03), operation composition (RP-04), CLI registry (RP-05), plan-review gate (RP-06)
propositions: RP-02 requires ordered exact-match retirement recovery at an explicit live-operation boundary with durable tombstone intent and no-op repeat semantics for concurrent binding state reconciliation.

RP-03 retains Jira-scoped breaker (3 consecutive exhausted operations across ≥2 tickets), singular retry ownership at the adapter level (max 3 physical invocations, 15s cumulative sleep per operation), and typed TicketPlan orchestration without duplicating persistence recovery.

RP-04 enforces explicit > environment > project > user > default precedence with per-operation snapshots, separate secret/provider boundary, CLI-over-environment precedence correction, and no Cloud adapter DIG fallback.
RP-05 normalizes all 21 visible advanced verbs onto side-effect-free package-data help; exact aliases reuse canonical help while compatibility shims retain alias-specific help naming replacement.

RP-06 approves effective applicability reversal (project LLM criteria now subject to routing predicates), parity-first Option-B failure projection (independent units continue, dependent units defer, failed units record coverage gaps), and explicit `review-plan --retry` only for latest INDETERMINATE with retryable missing calls.

Every behavior delta is explicitly marked as APPROVED DELTA or PRESERVE; all claims cite repository evidence, tests, or maintained-project prior art; seven RP-06 child stories and three RP-02/RP-03 epics decomposed with exact dependencies.
